measurementRules.rule: Q is the independently measured net whole-film mass newly first released in a cohort. Use a calibrated balance under total-dark conditions or a validated sealed-light-tight weighing method with independently measured actual bag/box/label tare. Keep actual moisture and complete support/emulsion/protective layers; do not add contained constituents again. Closing FG already belongs to Q.

Convert count or actual film area only with independently weighed same-lot whole-sheet net mass per counted sheet or measured actual-contour area. Record sample design and uncertainty. Nominal enclosing rectangle, camera count, native secondary coefficient, assumed thickness/density or silver content cannot establish mass. Integrated gas/liquid volume uses independently measured same-substance state density; only a true rate is integrated over time.

Metered kWh × 3.6 gives MJ once before allocation. This electricity property is an energy basis; it does not imply combustion, heating value per kg or a steam input. Match actual grid region, delivery voltage and included losses.

A purchased whole film, finished bag, box, tape or cleaning preparation is purchased once. Assay, carrier water and contained base/emulsion are non-additive subledgers. For actual in-house mixture preparation record each independently purchased ingredient and actual utilities/losses; bridge whole-preparation versus component reporting mutually exclusively.

calculationRules.rule: Convert raw extensive records to each row native unit first; integrate only true rates. kWh × 3.6 = MJ. Same-lot independently measured net-film mass/actual count or actual-contour area may convert count/area, never nominal rectangle or camera count. Use same-substance independently measured density/state for real volume conversions; keep whole/preparation/component bridges disjoint.
calculationRules.output: converted raw extensive records

calculationRules.rule: For every exchange dimension e, manufacturing A_e = B_open,e + U_e - B_close,e - T_other,e after conversion and justified attribution. Raw, WIP and genuinely unused non-WIP have separate physical stocks and inherited vectors. B_close excludes already released FG because Q includes it. T_other is a proven one-time transfer to another cohort/function, never a balancing plug. Retain actual failures, tests, zero output, idle, cleaning and rework; do not stock-correct an already net input again. B_open and B_close are inherited vectors of the unperformed stocks above; U is the newly incurred period exchange vector booked once. A genuine supplier return reverses its original burden once against the matching original receipt genealogy. This bookkeeping reversal neither scales down full physical return V nor creates an avoided-product credit.
calculationRules.output: manufacturing A_e for the first-release cohort

calculationRules.rule: For original cohort c and actually observed H: service A_e,c = opening unused/unassigned service vector + actual incremental service - closing genuinely unused/unassigned vector - proven independent transfer. Performed service is not subtracted because FG remains. Retain original Qc, history and all return/rework increments; H is not a divisor. Preserve original product burdens through delivery/reversal once without repurchasing them.
calculationRules.output: observed original-cohort service A_e,c

calculationRules.rule: For physical-event reporting select full converted actual V_e on that precise incoming/outgoing leg and destination. Film returns/dispatch, packing, assets, wet waste and individual species remain independent of A, stock differences, consumption, economic shares and service shares. A gross event adds no second provider burden or credit. X may only remove another explicitly identified same-side flow already represented in V, never stock/opposite-side quantities or card presence.
calculationRules.output: full physical V_e with one burden owner bridge

calculationRules.rule: The sole unit calculation is reported quantity = selected numerator / Qc once. Select manufacturing A_e, actual service A_e,c, or full physical V_e as separate labelled dimensions. Qc is the original unique newly first-released net film kg; first_release is 1 kg. Cards and collection aggregation reference this same calculated report with no further division. Qc=0 retains every real load/history for justified later attribution and yields no unit result.
calculationRules.output: one per-reference report with distinct burden and physical dimensions

calculationRules.rule: Independently close manufacturing, FG and combined whole-wet physical gates and each relevant element: opening physical stock + actual external receipts = closing physical stock + actual external exits, with measured physical transformations F explicitly bridged by species/phase. F is not a burden share or a fitted missing mass. Cancel internal first_release/receipt and other paired handoffs; do not add Q plus its closing FG as two outputs. Asset/packing stocks remain separate pools; one mixed waste and non-additive originW cannot become fictitious separated outlets. Unresolved chemistry remains unresolved. Measured generation F+ and consumption F- for a species/phase enter their respective equation: opening + real inputs + F+ = closing + real outputs + F-. Internal chemical/phase conversion adds no net whole-wet mass; genuine external addition/removal is an actual exchange. F cannot fit unknown silver/water/gas quantities.
calculationRules.output: independent physical and element reconciliation with uncertainty

calculationRules.rule: Lock Q0,c = sum of independently weighed unique first-accepted whole-film events q0,j for original cohort c at its one declared protected undeveloped gate; Q, Qc and Q0,c denote this same denominator, not shipment or a current survivor mass. Preserve each event and its original moisture/composition. Partition all original accepted material once: Q0,c = Dnet0,c + Ronsite0,c + Lirreversible0,c + Tother0,c. Dnet0 is material remaining outside in disjoint net deliveries after actual matching returns; Ronsite0 includes all actual on-site accepted material in held FG, returns, quarantine, rework, tests or other accepted states; Lirreversible0 includes original material actually evaporated, damaged, consumed or discarded; Tother0 is another real disjoint terminal disposition, including actual downstream development outside this endpoint. These are material-origin portions on the original acceptance mass ledger, not gross repeated deliveries or restored survivor masses. Reconcile them to separate current wet physical masses by actual retained independent additions/uptake and removals, with original versus added material origins and phase/element bridges; never restore original lost water into a survivor while also entering that water in L. Pre-acceptance raw, WIP and truly unused non-WIP belong to physical stock and inherited-load accounts but not Q0. Keep accepted material within those physical locations identified separately. Raw/WIP/FG returns, retests, redispatch and loops never generate another event. A proved erroneous initial acceptance requires an auditable original-cohort correction, not a convenient new denominator. H is actual service coverage; no future development or image lifetime enters manufacture or new Q. A zero current-period release/dispatch does not erase a positive original Q0 or its service result; only genuinely zero/unknown original Q0 leaves raw loads/history with no unit result.
calculationRules.output: original Q0 and separate wet material-origin bridge

calculationRules.rule: For each actual article and each manufacture, later-service and combined gate, use the whole-wet equation O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + Sgross + EO + Wwhole + J_out + H2O_out. O/C contain all actual empty, attached raw/WIP/non-WIP/FG and reusable stocks. P is independent new external procurement; I is actual packing received contained in a whole supply or in a paired internal handoff, excluding P/ER; ER is external return received, Sgross is full article mass leaving with gross product dispatch or paired internal handoff, EO is a separate outward return to its owner, and Wwhole is the actual discarded whole wet article. J_in/out are real non-water material added/removed; H2O_in/out are real independent water uptake/loss, including natural humidity without repair. None is a fitted residual. Terms are nonoverlapping: water/material already inside O/P/I/ER/C/Sgross/EO/Wwhole stays nested there, never added again as J/H2O. Full contaminated Wwhole includes substrate, retained cleaner, film residue and water once; do not create separately exported retained contents. Paired internal I/Sgross cancel only at the combined gate. For an expanded diagnostic equation, add OTHER_in - X_in to the left and OTHER_out - X_out to the right of the same equation. X only removes an explicitly identified OTHER same-side representation already contained in that side's gross flow; 0 <= X <= the proven duplicate OTHER. X cannot subtract O/C, any real J/H2O increment, an opposite-side leg or a merely present card. Actual repair/refill materials and outward removed matter need their exact atomic cards if present; the symbols do not assert that repair or moisture occurs. Keep physical amounts, provider burden ownership and service allocations distinct; no new Q, coproduct or avoided product from return/reuse.
calculationRules.output: separate complete whole-wet packing pools

calculationRules.rule: For each actually separate waste event t, retain receiver identity, Qt equal to the full as-transferred wet physical load, complete nested substrate/retained film/cleaner/water composition, collection/storage changes and actual complete treatment-provider interface. Separate liquid/cloth/film/packing rows apply only to material not already inside a mixed whole event. Determine the provider's full physical demand Ut = convert_actual(Qt, actual provider reference unit) using measured compatible mass/volume/state or actual batch interface, never an invented kg-to-item factor. Either use a genuine full treatment producer once or expand its real treatment, transport, utilities, residuals and emissions; include actual on-site pretreatment separately without repurchasing embedded work. Attribution is a different account: for every exchange e retain the full treatment vector Bt,e and original-cohort A_t,c,e plus other actual beneficiaries/unassigned portions; the portions are disjoint and sum to Bt,e. Use actual justified service drivers and original Q0,c for each A_t,c,e/Q0,c. Qt and Ut do not become the allocated share, and the full provider must not be charged again to each cohort. Prior treatment/service history and subsequent increments are distinguished once. Unknown assignment or provider unit bridge stays unresolved with full raw loads, not a smaller physical export or a zero treatment demand.
calculationRules.output: full Qt/Ut and disjoint A/Q0

calculationRules.rule: Use a configured fleet/service history for camera, holder, separately supplied lens/shutter, incident light meter, tripod, cable release, focusing loupe, light-tight loading tent, marking pen and actual cloth/tool fleet. Include each only when present and not already contained in a complete supplied configuration. Complete integrated configuration and separate procurement are mutually exclusive for the same item. Preserve original acquisition/receipt, full physical mass or actual native reference unit, opening/closing active/spare/repair/loan stock, returns, retirement, maintenance/replacement and performed use across all cohorts. Actual measured mass/area/count bridges convert compatible provider units; one item never equals one kg. Keep physical fleet balance separate from allocated service A; repeated use/dispatch does not repurchase the fleet. Same-article phase transitions, washing/refilling/repair and actual maintenance chemicals, electricity, parts and contaminated exits have distinct actual interfaces and own/provider histories once. Full retired article plus retained contents is one real waste load; nested components and service share do not shrink its physical receiver quantity. No default life, yield, use count, battery chemistry, pen refill or cleaning dose is supplied. If actual additional light sources, filters, cells, labels, tools or maintenance materials exist, add each specific atomic exchange and its complete provider/interface; an optional example never proves absence.
calculationRules.output: full physical fleet and disjoint service A/Q0

measurementRules.rule: Q为一批次新增首次放行整份胶片的独立实测净质量。使用全暗条件下经校准的天平，或经验证的密闭遮光称量法并独立实测袋/盒/标签实际皮重。保留实际含湿状态及完整片基/乳剂/保护层，不再另加内含组分。期末成品已包含在Q中。
按片数或实际片材面积换算时，只能使用独立称量的同批整片净质量与实测片数或实际轮廓面积，记录抽样设计和不确定性。标称包络矩形、相机数、原生次级系数、假定厚度/密度或含银量不能建立质量。已积分气液体积使用同物质实测状态密度；只有真实速率才对时间积分。
实测kWh先乘3.6一次换成MJ，再分配。此电力属性是能量基准，不代表燃烧、每kg热值或蒸汽投入。须匹配实际电网地域、交付电压及包含的损耗。
外购整份胶片、成品袋、盒、胶带或清洁制剂只采购一次。含量、载水和内含片基/乳剂为非加和子账。实际厂内配制须记录各独立外购组分和实际能源/损失；整份制剂与组分报告采用互斥桥接。

calculationRules.rule: 先将原始广延记录换成各行原生单位；只积分真实速率。kWh×3.6=MJ。同批独立实测胶片净质量/实际片数或实际轮廓面积可换算片数/面积，不能用标称矩形或相机数。真实体积换算使用同物质独立实测密度/状态，整份/制剂/组分桥接互斥。
calculationRules.output: 换算后的原始广延记录

calculationRules.rule: 各交换维度e的制造A_e=B_open,e+U_e-B_close,e-T_other,e，先换算并有理由归属。原料、在制品及真正未用非在制品分别有实物库存和继承向量。B_close不含已放行成品，因为Q已含该成品。T_other为有证据的一次性其他批次/功能转移，不是平账项。保留实际失败、测试、零产出、待机、清理和返工；已经按净投入记账的数量不再重复进行库存修正。 B_open和B_close是上述未履行库存的继承向量；U是本期间新发生且仅记一次的交换向量，真实供方退货仅按对应原收货谱系冲回一次原负荷。该账务冲回不缩减完整物理退货V，也不是避免产品抵扣。
calculationRules.output: 首次放行批次的制造A_e

calculationRules.rule: 对原批次c及实际观察H：服务A_e,c=期初未用/未归属服务向量+实际增量服务-期末真正未用/未归属向量-有证据的独立转移。不能因成品留存而扣除已发生服务。保留原Qc、历史及全部退回/返工增量，H不是除数。原产品负荷在交付/冲回中只保持一次，不重新采购。
calculationRules.output: 观察到的原批次服务A_e,c

calculationRules.rule: 物理事件报告选择该准确进出腿和目的地上换算后的完整实际V_e。胶片退回/发运、包装、资产、湿废物和各物种独立于A、库存差、消耗量、经济份额及服务份额。毛事件不新增第二供方负荷或抵扣。X只可消除V中已表征的另一明确同侧流，不能针对库存/对侧数量或卡片存在而扣减。
calculationRules.output: 与一次负荷归属桥接的完整物理V_e

calculationRules.rule: 唯一单位计算为报告数量=选定分子/Qc一次。制造A_e、实际服务A_e,c或完整物理V_e分别作为有标签的维度。Qc是原唯一新增首次放行胶片净kg，first_release为1kg。卡片和采集汇总引用同一计算报告，不再相除。Qc=0时保留全部真实负荷/历史供有理由的后续归属，不输出单位结果。
calculationRules.output: 一份负荷和物理维度分明的每参考流报告

calculationRules.rule: 独立闭合制造、成品及合并整湿物理边界和各相关元素：期初实物库存+实际外部接收=期末实物库存+实际外部出口，并按物种/相明确桥接实测物理转化F。F不是负荷份额或拟合缺失质量。抵消内部first_release/接收及其他成对交接，不把Q及其期末成品当两个输出。资产/包装保持独立池；一份混合废物和非加和originW不能变成虚构分流出口。未解决化学仍为未解决。 逐物种/相的实测生成F+与消耗F-必须分别进入对应方程：期初+实入+F+=期末+实出+F-。总整湿质量中，内部化学/相转化不产生净质量；真实外加/移出必须是实际交换，不能把F用作未知银/水/气体的拟合量。
calculationRules.output: 带不确定性的独立物理及元素核对

calculationRules.rule: 锁定原批c在唯一受保护未显影边界的 Q0,c = 各独立称重且唯一首次验收整片事件q0,j之和；Q、Qc、Q0,c均指此同一分母，绝非发运量或当前存活质量。保留每个事件及原含水/组成。原验收物质完整互斥分账：Q0,c = Dnet0,c + Ronsite0,c + Lirreversible0,c + Tother0,c。Dnet0是扣除真实匹配退回后仍在外部的互斥净交付原物质；Ronsite0包含留存成品、退回、隔离、返工、测试或其他验收状态中全部实际现场原物质；Lirreversible0含真实蒸发、损坏、消耗或丢弃的原物质；Tother0是另一真实互斥终端去向，包括本终端之外实际后续显影。这些是原验收质量账中的物质来源份额，不是重复毛发运或恢复后的存活质量。通过实际独立新增/吸收及移除、原物质与新增物质的来源、相态/元素桥接，另核当前湿实物质量；不能向存活物恢复原失水后又在L重复计失水。验收前原料、在制品和真正未加工非在制品进入实物/继承负荷账而非Q0；这些地点中已有验收物质须另辨识。原料/在制品/成品退回、复试、再发运和循环均不新增事件。证实首次验收错误须可审计地更正原批，不便利地另换分母。H为实际服务覆盖，不把未来显影或影像寿命纳入当前制造或新Q。当前期间放行/发运为零不抹掉正的原Q0或其服务结果；只有真正为零/未知的原Q0才保留原负荷历史而不出单位结果。
calculationRules.output: original Q0 and separate wet material-origin bridge

calculationRules.rule: 每种实际物品分别对制造、后续服务及合并边界使用全湿等式 O + P + I + ER + J_in + H2O_in = C + Sgross + EO + Wwhole + J_out + H2O_out。O/C含实际空置、附着原料/在制品/未加工非在制品/成品及可复用的全部库存。P是独立新增外购；I是整份供货内含或成对内部交接实际收到的包装，不含P/ER；ER为收到的外部退回，Sgross为随产品毛发运或成对内部交接外出的完整物品，EO为单独向所有者退还的出口，Wwhole为实际丢弃的整湿物品。J_in/out为真实非水物料增减；H2O_in/out为真实独立水分吸收/损失，包括没有修理的自然湿气变化；均不得拟合残差。各项互斥：O/P/I/ER/C/Sgross/EO/Wwhole中已含的水和物料只作嵌套，不能再加为J/H2O。Wwhole含基材、残留清洁剂、胶片残留和水一次，不能虚构另行外排的内含物。成对内部I/Sgross仅在合并边界抵消。扩展诊断等式在同一等式左侧加 OTHER_in - X_in，右侧加 OTHER_out - X_out。X仅可移除该侧毛流内已包含、已明确识别的OTHER同侧重复表示；0 <= X <= 有证据的重复OTHER。X不能扣O/C、任何真实J/H2O增量、反向腿或仅有卡片。实际修理/补充物料及真实移出物若存在，需其具体原子卡；符号并不宣称有修理或吸湿。实物流、供方负荷所有权和服务分配分账，退还/复用不产生新Q、共产品或避免产品。
calculationRules.output: separate complete whole-wet packing pools

calculationRules.rule: 每个真实分离废物事件t保留接收者、Qt为按交付状态的完整湿实物量、完整嵌套基材/残留胶片/清洁剂/水组成、收集/保管库存变化及真实完整处理供方接口。分离液体/布/胶片/包装卡仅用于不在混合整物事件内的物质。供方完整实物需求 Ut = convert_actual(Qt, 真实供方参考单位)，以实测兼容质量/体积/状态或实际批次接口转换，不能编千克到件的系数。真实完整处理生产者仅链接一次，或展开真实处理、运输、公用、残余及排放；现场实际预处理单列，不重买已内含工作。归属是另一本账：每交换e保留完整处理向量Bt,e和原批A_t,c,e及其他实际受益/未归属份额；份额互斥且合计Bt,e。采用真实合理服务驱动，分别按各原Q0,c报告A_t,c,e/Q0,c。Qt、Ut不变成分配份额，也不能向每个批次各计整份供方。原处理/服务历史与后续增量分别一次。归属未知或供方单位桥未知须保留全量原账和未解决结果，不能缩实物出口或记零处理。
calculationRules.output: full Qt/Ut and disjoint A/Q0

calculationRules.rule: 为相机、片夹、另供镜头/快门、入射式测光表、三脚架、快门线、对焦放大镜、避光装片帐、标记笔及实际布/工具建立配置实物与服务历史。仅在真实存在且不已包含于整份配置时纳入；同一物件的完整配置与另购互斥。保留原购置/收料、完整实物质量或真实原生参考单位，期初/末使用中/备用/修理/借用库存、退还、退役、维护/替换及跨全部批次已执行使用。真实实测质量/面积/件数桥转换兼容供方单位，一件不等于一千克。实物fleet平衡独立于已分配服务A，重复使用/发运不重复采购。同一物件状态变化、洗涤/补充/修理及真实维护化学品、电力、部件和污染出口具有独立实际接口及自有/供方历史一次。完整退役物及残留内容是一项真实废物流，嵌套成分和服务份额不能缩小实物接收量。不设寿命、收率、使用次数、电池化学体系、笔芯补充或清洁剂量默认值。实际存在其他光源、滤镜、电池、标签、工具或维护物料，须各加具体原子交换及完整供方/接口；可选示例不能证明不存在。
calculationRules.output: full physical fleet and disjoint service A/Q0

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 用完整操作/身份记录证明准确整份产品及光学曝光/未显影状态，不以已显影负片可见检测或仅收料授权替代。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 胶片批次；曝光/片夹日志；放行/偏差记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留经校准的未归一化原始测量、原单位/状态和不确定性。每项真实数量属于前景实测，不把来源图表或通用默认值当实测。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 校准；皮重；原始表计和称量表；抽样设计

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 覆盖完整实际生产/批期及观察H，包括全部失败/零产出/清理/返工事件和逐流继承原料/在制品/未用非在制品/成品向量。解释并保留每个平衡缺口。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 事件谱系；库存向量；完整阶段及物理账

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 应用完整原生名称/同义词/注释/CAS和全部属性限制、类型、供给路线、形态、地理及介质。保留正式中文流名称。原生身份不建立供方技术、数量、审批或组成。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整原生对象及准确属性/单位链；供方比对

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 区分制造商结构/实践、概念化学、分配方法及实际前景测量。保留历史版本及邻近不兼容反例，不暗示全部来源描述同一工厂或当代SKU。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原始上下文；适用性决定；带日期供方/前景记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 采用整份湿废物或有桥接的互斥实测组分；实际物种/去向及银等相关元素证据独立保留。不用一个多未知残差修补缺流。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 称量；组成/物种；接收方；originW；平衡不确定性

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 记录专属/虚拟拆分、各决定性物理关系和仅真正剩余部分的共同门市场价值及敏感性。不用已分配负荷比例缩放毛物理出口。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 计量/使用图；因果理由；同状态价值；敏感性
